correctness.rationale: Unique H parametrization and invariant action verified algebraically. The fourth-power energy identity has positive mixed terms. Comparison with max(L,|b|) is exact and both blocks provide equality, while L is obtained by an analytically solved trigonometric supremum, including all degeneracies. Symbolic proof identities replayed on actual verify.py; Markov witness is rational.

evidence: Bouthat et al. treat A(n,±a,b), all off-diagonals equal, and state that p>2 induced norms of the negative-diagonal family remain bounded rather than exact.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Those special two-parameter classes do not dominate arbitrary four-parameter real circulant kernels on the centered subspace. Results for full-space nonnegative kernels give trivial full-space norm one but do not compute contraction on H.

originality.rationale: The critical earlier two-dimensional radical (public record 7a18ef79086d) has been explicitly identified and read. That formula by itself does not provide a three-dimensional centered convolution norm. The quartic Fourier-block gluing identity and sharp universal four-state Markov spectral gap are proved here. ArXiv full-text comparisons deal with special circulant families or Hilbert norms, not the all-kernel centered real L4 norm. Further unindexed literature may contain an equivalent statement.
residual_risks: A buried general Fourier-multiplier norm theorem might imply the special four-state case without matching search terms.
The two-dimensional radical is already public; value rests on the independent three-coordinate gluing identity and the Markov sharpness consequence, not on rediscovering that radical.

value.rationale: The exact formula classifies all real signed four-state cyclic filters acting on the natural centered Banach space, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The sharp spectral-versus-L4 ratio 2^(1/4), realized by a standard lazy directed Markov walk, quantifies genuine non-Hilbert one-step mixing behavior and provides a reusable small-state benchmark. Only the two-dimensional ingredient is already known.
